method: Fresh processes. One process runs at a time. 3 warmups and 21 measured rounds per CLI condition in each batch (public corpus, then new faults). Workload order and first tool rotate within each batch. Wall through exit with outputs drained. Input fixtures and project lock identical for both TIDE versions. Every output checked by status, structure and SHA-256. Median is sorted observation 11 of 21. This measures CLI responses, not model sessions. Output token counts include final newline using gpt-tokenizer o200k_base.

external_context_comparator.modification: Scalar differences in the new fixtures use top-level expected and actual fields, matching TIDE.

stages: also validate schema and decode typed data
stage_method.order: rotate stage and version each round; CPU 2, serial, fresh process
stage_method.build: Concatenate listed modules, each followed by a newline, append stufen.tide; build/native/seed probe < all.tide > probe.cpp; c++ -std=c++20 -O1 -fno-ident -Wl,--build-id=none -s -static probe.cpp -o probe; feed JSON by stdin with one stage argument (read, spans, index, decode).
stage_method.input: compact JSON array of n rows with sequence = i+1 and balance = i mod 20, zero-based i

controls.preceding_corpus: Control project construction documented in ../46_ergebnisvergleich/bericht.md. Source of posting.tide identical to the ledger fixture.
controls.wide: 64 records with n = 8 or 48 integer fields named f0..f(n-1); row index i and field j store i+j. Order canonical, descending or rotated by i mod n. Public command returns length rows. A separate identity function checks all field values.

validation.without_python: make check-no-python returned 0, uncached build and installed stages, network=none during test execution
